summary: Secure client-rule posture. The deployed Firestore rules deny every client read and write. Firebase Storage is not provisioned for this project; the repository includes a deny-all rule template that must be activated if Storage is deliberately introduced. PHFD Capital routes data operations through the Cloud Run service account and Admin SDK, where IAM and server-side authorization apply. No create/update bypass, client authority field, ownership bypass, type confusion, or storage exhaustion path exists through Firebase client rules.
